verdict.rationale: Sketch ships an official write-capable JavaScript Plugin API and a built-in local MCP Server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT/Claude interact directly with Sketch, plus AI features (build frames in code, generate palettes, rename layers) that go beyond read-only inspection, showing agents can create/modify designs programmatically. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's write capabilities or plugin API in practice, and no public REST/OpenAPI write API confirmed (probe shows 404s).
